custom_size_pending.en: Not applied yet — press Apply Custom Size.
custom_size_pending.zh-TW: 尚未套用 — 請按「套用自訂大小」。

preferences_more_note.en: Additional application preferences may be added later.
preferences_more_note.zh-TW: 未來可能新增其他應用程式偏好設定。

remember_window_size.en: Remember last window size and position
remember_window_size.zh-TW: 記住上次的視窗大小與位置

remember_window_size_note.en: When on, the last window size and position are restored at the next launch and take priority over Startup Window. Choosing a size above still applies immediately. Reset clears the remembered geometry and returns to Auto.
remember_window_size_note.zh-TW: 開啟時，下次啟動會還原上次的視窗大小與位置，並優先於「啟動視窗」設定。在上方選擇尺寸仍會立即套用。重設會清除記住的位置並回到自動。

window_fit_note.en: Presets larger than the current work area are fitted to the screen.
window_fit_note.zh-TW: 大於目前可用工作區的預設尺寸會自動縮放以符合螢幕。
